csv_project_name: On Call Structural Member Fabrication Inspection
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a consultant to provide on-call inspection services for structural steel and prestressed concrete structural members being fabricated in plants inside and out of the State of Indiana in accordance with the Standard Specifications, ASSHTO/AWS D1.5 Bridge Welding Code, the General Instructions to Field Employees.

title: On-Call Structural Member Fabrication Inspection
short_description: On-call inspection of fabricated bridge structural members for Indiana transportation projects.
project_location: Indianapolis, Indiana, USA; fabrication plants inside and outside the State of Indiana
project_scope: On-call inspection services for fabrication of structural steel and prestressed concrete structural members for transportation structures, carried out at fabrication plants within and outside Indiana, in accordance with Indiana Standard Specifications, AASHTO/AWS D1.5 Bridge Welding Code, and General Instructions to Field Employees.
services: Inspection services for fabricated structural members; structural engineering support related to fabrication inspection of structural steel and prestressed concrete members.
relevance_explanation:
- Related to bridge structural members, which is generally relevant to sbp's bridge expertise.
- However, the tender is primarily for inspection services, not design, structural concept development, or planning phases.
- Scope appears to be an on-call framework-style service without a specific technically ambitious structure.
- No indication of large spans, innovative structural systems, sustainability focus, or architecturally demanding content.
- Could be of limited strategic interest as quality/fabrication expertise, but overall only moderately relevant.
construction_cost_explanation: The source states "Contract value: $4.0M". As the notice is for consultant inspection services rather than construction works, this value is treated as the stated contract value from the tender documents, although it is not a construction cost in the strict sense.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning or engineering fee for sbp-type services is stated. The only monetary figure given is the overall contract value of 4.0 million USD for on-call inspection services.

notes: Advance notice only. RFQ/RFP No. 2609, Project No. 21860, expected to be available prior to 10/01/2026. IMS requests no phone calls, no faxes, and no contact with the agency at this time.
